result.title: GEKey: Learning Geodesic Eccentric 3D Keypoints via Self-Supervision
result.summary: Point clouds represent 3D object geometry as sets of spatial coordinates. A fundamental task in their analysis is keypoint detection, i.e., identifying a sparse subset of points that captures the most salient features. While supervised methods rely on manual annotations, unsupervised approaches leverage intrinsic geometric properties to localize keypoints without human input. We introduce GEKey, a self-supervised framework that uses the geodesic eccentricity transform, an SE(3)-invariant geometric measure, to identify instance-specific salient points. These points serve as pseudo-labels to train a model that aligns its predictions with the object's intrinsic structure. GEKey is simple, efficient, and robust, preserving intra-class variation by balancing instance-specific and category-level structure. Extensive experiments on ShapeNetCoreV2, KeypointNet, CAPE, ITOP, and DeformingThings4D show state-of-the-art performance in both keypoint detection and alignment, with strong resilience to noise, downsampling, deformations, and real-world conditions. The code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/Pierreoo/GEKey.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GEKey，一个自监督 3D 点云关键点检测框架：以 SE(3) 不变的大地测地偏心度变换刻画实例内的显著点，并将其作为伪标签训练检测模型，在多个点云数据集上做检测与对齐评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文用内在几何测度衡量「哪些点最具信息量」并据此稀疏筛选，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与显著性先验提供可核查的概念线索，但其本身不涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态。
